parameters.query:
SELECT id, user_query, agent_response, intent, retrieved_kb_ids, feedback_score, needs_review
FROM interaction_logs
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND (feedback_score = 0 OR needs_review = true)
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 20;

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: { count: items.length, flagged: items } }];

parameters.query: SELECT prompt_text FROM system_prompts WHERE prompt_type = 'evaluator' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1;
SELECT id, prompt_text FROM system_prompts WHERE prompt_type = 'base' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: SELECT id, category, question, expected_behavior, severity FROM evaluation_cases WHERE active = true ORDER BY category;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-5.4-nano', max_completion_tokens: 500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('Parse Synthesized Prompt').first().json.candidate_prompt_text }, { role: 'user', content: $json.question } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-5.4-nano', max_completion_tokens: 2000, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a strict evaluator judging AI assistant answers against expected behavior criteria. You will receive a JSON array of test cases, each with category, severity, question, expected_behavior, and actual_answer. For each case, judge whether actual_answer satisfies expected_behavior.
